
------------------------------------------------------------------------
★ EXTRACTION OF DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION RESULTS & VOLCANO PLOT ★
------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# 1. Extract Differential Expression results comparing Day6 v. Day0 baseline
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Day", "Day_6", "Day_0"))

# 2. Convert to tidy dataframe for ggplot compatibility
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Upregulated Genes (Day6)",
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Downregulated Genes (Day6)",
    TRUE  ~ "Not Significant"
  ))

# 3. Define the explicit Ensembl ID to Gene Symbol map based on project key
gene_map <- c(
  "ENSG00000087586.17" = "AURKA",   "ENSG00000163220.10" = "S100A9",
  "ENSG00000134824.13" = "FANCI",   "ENSG00000170485.16" = "NPAT",
  "ENSG00000101670.11" = "LIPG",    "ENSG00000197635.9"  = "DPP4",
  "ENSG00000100985.7"  = "MMP25",   "ENSG00000164611.12" = "PTTG1",
  "ENSG00000099194.5"  = "SCD",     "ENSG00000112494.9"  = "SLC16A7",
  "ENSG00000125740.13" = "FOSB",    "ENSG00000085741.12" = "MGMT",
  "ENSG00000149043.16" = "SYT1",    "ENSG00000018280.16" = "SLC11A1",
  "ENSG00000171223.5"  = "JUN",     "ENSG00000170345.9"  = "FOS",
  "ENSG00000120738.7"  = "EGR1",    "ENSG00000167552.13" = "TUBA1A",
  "ENSG00000124249.6"  = "KIF5C",   "ENSG00000203747.10" = "CXCL8"
)

# Map Ensembl IDs to Gene Symbols in the dataframe (fallback to original ID if unmapped)
res_df <- res_df %>%
  mutate(gene_symbol = ifelse(gene_id %in% names(gene_map), gene_map[gene_id], gene_id))

# 4. Extract Top 10 Upregulated Genes based on padj
top_upreg_genes <- res_df %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(10)

# 5. Extract Top 10 Downregulated Genes based on padj
top_downreg_genes <- res_df %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(10)

# Combine them into a single dataframe for plot labeling
genes_to_label <- bind_rows(top_upreg_genes, top_downreg_genes)

# Print verification summaries to the console
print("Top 10 Upregulated Genes selected for labeling:")
print(top_upreg_genes[, c("gene_id", "gene_symbol", "log2FoldChange", "padj")])
print("Top 10 Downregulated Genes selected for labeling:")
print(top_downreg_genes[, c("gene_id", "gene_symbol", "log2FoldChange", "padj")])

# 6. Generate the labeled Volcano Plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Upregulated Genes (Day6)" = "firebrick3",
    "Downregulated Genes (Day6)" = "dodgerblue3",
    "Not Significant" = "grey60"
  )) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Smart text labeling layer to prevent overlaps
  geom_text_repel(
    data = genes_to_label,
    aes(label = gene_symbol),
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    segment.size = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot of Differential Gene Expression",
    subtitle = "HGSOC Patient Organoids: Day 6 v. Day 0 Baseline",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (LFC)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted p-value (FDR)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(volcano_plot)

# 7. Save the final labeled plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "HGSOC_Volcano_Plot.png"),
  plot = volcano_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
